header.title: Community
header.subtitle: You are not alone. Here you can feel the presence of others without pressure.

stories_card.title: Read and Share Stories
stories_card.quote: "In the stories section, I finally found words for what I had experienced. I realized I wasn't crazy."

no_chat.title: Why is there no chat?
no_chat.text: Turvasiipi is designed with a 'Privacy-First' principle. We do not store your data on a server, so we cannot offer real-time chat. This is a choice for your safety.

wellbeing.title: Your Wellbeing
wellbeing.text: Remember that peer support is important, but it does not replace professional help in severe burnout.
wellbeing.link: Do you need professional help? See Contacts →
